title: Silver Hand
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. Every Silver Hand record is a wrapper in `SilverHandFaction` 0AA0A4 that takes its level (`Stats`) from a bandit list but keeps its own name, inventory and outfit. No DLC or CC pack adds one. bands-of-power.md puts the Silver Hand in Experienced (V); archetype-tiers.md §3.1 gives the mooks three new lists of bandit rungs (14 ×1 · 19 ×3 · 25 ×1, Trained to Blooded) and leaves the bosses on the bandit chief (28), so the mooks' band is open.

families.holds: the melee, two-handed, archer and ambush wrappers (bandit ladder 1 · 5 · 9 · 14 · 19 · 25) and the placed corpses
`LvlSilverhandBoss` (bandit boss ladder 6 · 10 · 16 · 21 · 28), Krev the Skinner, and the radiant camp leader
